contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C VI[CTORINVS AVG] ; R/ [P]AX AVG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), cf. Cunetio no. 2514. Obverse description: radiate bust bearded right. Obverse inscription: IMP C VI[CTORINVS AVG]. Reverse description: Pax standing left with transverse sceptre holding sprig aloft. Star of six points in left field. Reverse inscription: [P]AX AVG. Diameter: 19mm, Weight: 2.34gms, die axis: 6
